title: Scion
author: James Islington
note: conf=0.72; Scion (2026), James Islington's first sci-fi/cyberpunk novel, published Sept 1 2026 (Saga Press US, ISBN 9781668239261 for the ebook; 9781668239247 hardcover). Confirmed as the FIRST book in a new planned series: the author's own announcement says "It's now the first in a planned series," and Text Publishing lists it as "Book 1 in an electrifying new series." The series has no separately announced name yet, so it is being tracked under the title of the first book ("Scion" series, #1) — the series-name portion is inferred from the title; the "book 1 of a series" status itself is publisher-confirmed. Distinct from Islington's Hierarchy series and Licanius Trilogy.
